name: Manastorm Blackrock Depths Magmus: a Shadowforge Flame Keeper drops a Shadowforge Torch
contract: The Magmus stage (segment 428) needs Shadowforge Torches (11885) to light the braziers that open the Magmus
doors. The torch comes from Shadowforge Flame Keepers (9956), but Manastorm sets loot mode 0 on every stage
creature, so the keepers dropped nothing and the stage could not be completed. A player killing a keeper in
the stage now finds exactly one torch on a lootable corpse. The drop is guaranteed so the stage can always
be finished; the stage's other loot stays suppressed, and a corpse that already holds a torch gets no second
one. Pool 1550 spawns two of its four keepers at random and three of them patrol, so the case summons a
keeper without an owner in the Lyceum: Manastorm sets loot mode 0 on it as on the pooled keepers.
Manastorm scales the keeper's health below half of its native health, so the scaling also resizes the player
damage requirement; otherwise no kill was credited to the player and the corpse got no loot owner. The torch
is a free-for-all item, so it joins the loot while the core fills it: added after the kill, no looter saw it.
The player takes the torch from their own free-for-all view and must then carry it.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the keeper is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble clears its safety aura
CONTROL: the player starts without a Shadowforge Torch
Add a keeper that, like a pooled one, is not player-created
The keeper's corpse holds one Shadowforge Torch
Take the torch from this player's own view of the free-for-all loot
The player now carries the Shadowforge Torch
The stage's ordinary loot stays suppressed
